# Stashlog: Home Inventory

> Free, private, open-source home inventory app for iPhone (iOS 26+). Film a room walkthrough; on-device AI (Apple Vision) identifies belongings; read serial numbers and receipts on-device; export an insurance-ready PDF and CSV.

- Price: free. No in-app purchases, no subscription, no ads.
- Privacy: no account, no servers, no analytics. Video and photos are processed on the iPhone and never uploaded.
- Works offline. Works on iPhones without Apple Intelligence (e.g., iPhone 11, 12, 13).
- License: GPLv3. Source: https://github.com/rshamilton/Stashlog
